label: A-probe-2
finalMessage:
The title limit is now 200 characters. I didn't run the app or any tests.

- **`db/migrations/001_create_tasks.sql:3`:** the check is now `length(title) between 1 and 200`.
- **`lib/tasks.ts:19`:** I also changed the app-level validation and its error message to 200. It had the same hard-coded limit, so titles of 121–200 characters would still have been rejected before reaching the database.
- **`README.md:29`:** the rules table now says 1..200.

Editing the first migration only affects databases created from now on. Any existing database was created with the 120 limit. SQLite can't alter a check constraint in place, so you would need to recreate the table or reset the database.
